📈 Quadratic Functions二次函数

Graphs & characteristics图象与特征

A basketball shot, a jet of water, a satellite dish — all parabolas. Six facts (vertex, axis, max/min, domain, range, intercepts) tell you everything about the curve.投篮的轨迹、喷泉的水柱、卫星锅的截面都是抛物线。顶点、对称轴、最值、定义域、值域、截距——掌握这六样，就看懂了整条曲线。

Difficulty难度 ●○○
⏱ 25 min · ★ essential必会

🔑 Must know必须记住 · Graphs & characteristics图象与特征
  1. a>0 opens up (minimum), a<0 opens down (maximum); the vertex sits on the axis x=−2ab​.a>0 开口向上（有最小值），a<0 开口向下（有最大值）；顶点在对称轴 x=−2ab​ 上。
  2. Range uses the vertex y-value: y≥q (up) or y≤q (down). Domain is always all real numbers.值域看顶点的纵坐标：开口向上 y≥q，向下 y≤q。定义域永远是全体实数。
  3. Axis = midpoint of the zeros, or of any two points at the same height.对称轴 = 两个零点的中点，或任意两个等高点的中点。
x=−2ab​
xaxis​=2r+s​

🧗 The hard part难点 · Graphs & characteristics图象与特征

Finding the axis by symmetry用对称性找对称轴

Students only know x=−2ab​ and freeze when no equation is given.很多人只会 x=−2ab​，题目不给方程就卡住。

  1. f(x1​)=f(x2​) ⇒ axis x=2x1​+x2​​f(x1​)=f(x2​) ⇒ 对称轴 x=2x1​+x2​​
  2. Zeros r,s are equal heights too: axis x=2r+s​零点 r,s 也是等高点：对称轴 x=2r+s​
  3. Vertex =(axis, max or min value); then a from one more point顶点 =（对称轴，最值）；再用一个点求 a
Try试一试
A parabola passes through (−3,7) and (5,7) and has minimum value −9. Find the vertex and the range.抛物线过 (−3,7) 和 (5,7)，最小值为 −9。求顶点和值域。
Answer答案
Vertex (1,−9); range y≥−9顶点 (1,−9)；值域 y≥−9

⚠️ Traps & tip陷阱与提示 · Graphs & characteristics图象与特征
  • Axis of y=2x2+8x as x=2 → x=−2(2)8​=−2 (keep the minus).y=2x2+8x 的对称轴写成 x=2 → 应为 x=−2(2)8​=−2（别丢负号）。
  • Range from the vertex x-value (y≥2 for vertex (2,−5)) → use the y-value: y≥−5.用顶点横坐标写值域（顶点 (2,−5) 写成 y≥2）→ 用纵坐标：y≥−5。
🎯
Find the axis first: one substitution then gives the vertex, the max/min and the range.先求对称轴，再代入一次，顶点、最值、值域全出来。

📈 Quadratic Functions二次函数

Vertex form & transformations顶点式与图象变换

Why memorize dozens of parabolas? Every one of them is just y=x2 stretched, flipped and slid — and vertex form tells you exactly how.何必死记各种抛物线？每一条都只是 y=x2 经过拉伸、翻折、平移得到的——顶点式把怎么变的全写在脸上。

Difficulty难度 ●●○
⏱ 30 min · ★ essential必会

🔑 Must know必须记住 · Vertex form & transformations顶点式与图象变换
  1. y=a(x−p)2+q: vertex (p,q), axis x=p. (x+3)2 means p=−3.y=a(x−p)2+q：顶点 (p,q)，对称轴 x=p。(x+3)2 表示 p=−3。
  2. ∣a∣>1 narrower, ∣a∣<1 wider, a<0 flips. From the vertex: over 1, 2, 3 → up a, 4a, 9a.∣a∣>1 变窄，∣a∣<1 变宽，a<0 翻转。从顶点出发：右移 1、2、3 → 上升 a、4a、9a。
  3. x-intercepts: a,q opposite signs → 2; q=0 → 1; same signs → 0.x 截距个数：a,q 异号 → 2 个；q=0 → 1 个；同号 → 0 个。
y=a(x−p)2+q
(x,y) → (x+p, ay+q)

🧗 The hard part难点 · Vertex form & transformations顶点式与图象变换

Equation from the vertex and one point由顶点和一个点写方程

People put the vertex in with the wrong signs or substitute the vertex itself to find a.常见错误是顶点代入时符号写反，或拿顶点本身去求 a。

  1. Vertex (−2,5): y=a(x+2)2+5顶点 (−2,5)：y=a(x+2)2+5
  2. Other point (1,−13): −13=a(3)2+5另一点 (1,−13)：−13=a(3)2+5
  3. 9a=−18⇒a=−2
  4. Sense check: point below the vertex ⇒ a<0检验：点在顶点下方 ⇒ a<0
Try试一试
Write the equation of the parabola with vertex (−2,5) through (1,−13).写出顶点为 (−2,5) 且过 (1,−13) 的抛物线方程。
Answer答案
y=−2(x+2)2+5

⚠️ Traps & tip陷阱与提示 · Vertex form & transformations顶点式与图象变换
  • Vertex of y=2(x+5)2−1 as (5,−1) → (−5,−1).y=2(x+5)2−1 的顶点写成 (5,−1) → 应为 (−5,−1)。
  • a=31​ called narrower → vertical stretch by 31​ makes it wider.a=31​ 说成变窄 → 竖直伸缩因子 31​，图象变宽。
🎯
To find a, substitute the OTHER point, not the vertex: one line gives a=(x1​−p)2y1​−q​.求 a 时代入另一个点，别代顶点：一行得 a=(x1​−p)2y1​−q​。

📈 Quadratic Functions二次函数

Standard form → vertex form一般式化顶点式

y=2x2−12x+7 hides its vertex. Rewrite it as y=2(x−3)2−11 and the lowest point (3,−11) is sitting right there.y=2x2−12x+7 把顶点藏起来了。改写成 y=2(x−3)2−11，最低点 (3,−11) 一眼就看到。

Difficulty难度 ●●○
⏱ 35 min · ★ essential必会

🔑 Must know必须记住 · Standard form → vertex form一般式化顶点式
  1. x2+bx=(x+2b​)2−(2b​)2
  2. a=1: factor a from the x2 and x terms only; the subtracted square leaves the bracket times a.a=1：只从 x2 项和 x 项提出 a；减掉的平方数移出括号时要乘 a。
  3. Check: vertex x=−2ab​, vertex y=f(−2ab​).检验：顶点横坐标 x=−2ab​，纵坐标 y=f(−2ab​)。
x2+bx=(x+2b​)2−(2b​)2
y=ax2+bx+c ⇒ p=−2ab​, q=f(p)

🧗 The hard part难点 · Standard form → vertex form一般式化顶点式

Completing the square with negative aa 为负数时配方

Two signs and the factor a must be tracked at the same time.要同时盯住两个符号和因子 a。

  1. y=−2x2+8x+3=−2(x2−4x)+3
  2. =−2(x2−4x+4−4)+3
  3. =−2(x−2)2+8+3 since (−2)(−4)=+8=−2(x−2)2+8+3，因为 (−2)(−4)=+8
  4. =−2(x−2)2+11; check f(2)=−8+16+3=11=−2(x−2)2+11；验 f(2)=−8+16+3=11
Try试一试
Write y=3x2+18x+20 in vertex form.把 y=3x2+18x+20 化成顶点式。
Answer答案
y=3(x+3)2−7

⚠️ Traps & tip陷阱与提示 · Standard form → vertex form一般式化顶点式
  • 3(x2−4x+4−4)+5=3(x−2)2+1 → the −4 leaves as −12: 3(x−2)2−7.3(x2−4x+4−4)+5=3(x−2)2+1 → −4 出括号变成 −12：3(x−2)2−7。
  • −x2+6x=−(x2+6x) → −(x2−6x).−x2+6x=−(x2+6x) → 应为 −(x2−6x)。
🎯
Only need the vertex? Skip the square: x=−2ab​, then substitute.只要顶点？不用配方：x=−2ab​，再代入。

📈 Quadratic Functions二次函数

Factored form & writing equations交点式与求解析式

You see where a parabola crosses the x-axis and one other point on it. That is enough to write its exact equation in one line.只要知道抛物线和 x 轴的两个交点，再加上它上面的任意一点，一行就能写出它的精确方程。

Difficulty难度 ●○○
⏱ 30 min · ★ essential必会

🔑 Must know必须记住 · Factored form & writing equations交点式与求解析式
  1. y=a(x−r)(x−s): zeros r,s (opposite signs to the brackets); axis x=2r+s​.y=a(x−r)(x−s)：零点 r,s（与括号里符号相反）；对称轴 x=2r+s​。
  2. Zeros alone do not fix the parabola: always use a third point to find a.只有零点定不出抛物线：一定要用第三个点求 a。
  3. Touches the x-axis only at r: y=a(x−r)2.只在 r 处与 x 轴相切：y=a(x−r)2。
y=a(x−r)(x−s)
x=2r+s​

🧗 The hard part难点 · Factored form & writing equations交点式与求解析式

Zeros + one point → the full equation零点＋一个点 → 完整方程

Students write (x−r)(x−s) and forget the unknown a.常写成 (x−r)(x−s) 就停，忘了未知的 a。

  1. Zeros −2,6: y=a(x+2)(x−6)零点 −2,6：y=a(x+2)(x−6)
  2. Point (0,9): 9=a(2)(−6)⇒a=−43​点 (0,9)：9=a(2)(−6)⇒a=−43​
  3. Axis x=2: y=−43​(4)(−4)=12 → vertex (2,12)对称轴 x=2：y=−43​(4)(−4)=12 → 顶点 (2,12)
Try试一试
A parabola has zeros −2 and 6 and y-intercept 9. Find its maximum value.抛物线零点为 −2 和 6，y 截距为 9。求最大值。
Answer答案
Maximum 12 at x=2最大值 12（在 x=2 处）

⚠️ Traps & tip陷阱与提示 · Factored form & writing equations交点式与求解析式
  • y=(x+4)(x−1) zeros 4,−1 → −4,1.y=(x+4)(x−1) 的零点写成 4,−1 → 应为 −4,1。
  • 3x2−3x−18=(x−3)(x+2) → 3(x−3)(x+2) (keep a).3x2−3x−18=(x−3)(x+2) → 应为 3(x−3)(x+2)（保留 a）。
🎯
Vertex from factored form: midpoint of the zeros, then substitute; no expanding.交点式求顶点：取零点中点再代入，不用展开。

📈 Quadratic Functions二次函数

Max/min problems最值应用题

Raise the ticket price and fewer people come; lower it and you earn less per ticket. Somewhere in between is the price that earns the most — and it sits at the vertex of a parabola.票价提高，来的人就少；票价降低，每张又赚得少。中间总有一个收入最高的价格——它就在一条抛物线的顶点上。

Difficulty难度 ●●○
⏱ 40 min · ★ essential必会

🧗 The hard part难点 · Max/min problems最值应用题

Setting up a revenue function列收入函数

The variable is the number of increases, not the price, and two things change at once.变量是涨价次数而不是价格，而且价格和销量同时变。

  1. n = number of 1-dollar increasesn = 涨 1 元的次数
  2. R=(12+n)(200−10n)
  3. Zeros n=−12, 20 → best n=2−12+20​=4零点 n=−12, 20 → 最优 n=2−12+20​=4
  4. Price 12+4=16; R=16×160=2560价格 12+4=16；R=16×160=2560
Try试一试
A café sells 200 drinks a day at 12 dollars each. Each 1-dollar rise loses 10 sales. Which price maximizes revenue?一家咖啡店每天以每杯 12 元卖 200 杯。每涨 1 元少卖 10 杯。定价多少收入最高？
Answer答案
16 dollars, revenue 2560 dollars a day16 元，每天收入 2560 元

⚠️ Traps & tip陷阱与提示 · Max/min problems最值应用题
  • "What is the max height?" answered t=3 → give h(3).「最大高度是多少？」答 t=3 → 应答 h(3)。
  • Answering n=4 as the price → price is p0​+4.把 n=4 当成价格 → 价格是 p0​+4。
🎯
Keep revenue in factored form (p0​+n)(q0​−kn); the midpoint of its zeros beats expanding.收入保持因式形式 (p0​+n)(q0​−kn)；取零点中点比展开快。

quiz.q: For y=−2x2+8x−3, state the vertex, max or min value, and range.对 y=−2x2+8x−3，写出顶点、最值和值域。
quiz.a: vertex (2,5), maximum 5, range y≤5顶点 (2,5)，最大值 5，值域 y≤5

quiz.goal: Find the vertex, maximum value and range of a downward-opening parabola.求开口向下抛物线的顶点、最大值和值域。

quiz.q: Find the x-intercepts and y-intercept of y=x2+2x−8.求 y=x2+2x−8 的 x 截距和 y 截距。
quiz.a: x-intercepts −4 and 2; y-intercept −8x 截距 −4 和 2；y 截距 −8
quiz.sol: • (x+4)(x−2)=0 gives x=−4, 2. y-intercept is c=−8.(x+4)(x−2)=0，得 x=−4, 2。y 截距是 c=−8。
quiz.goal: Find both kinds of intercepts of a quadratic.求二次函数的两类截距。
quiz.idea: y-intercept: set x=0 (it is c). x-intercepts: set y=0 and factor.y 截距：令 x=0（就是 c）；x 截距：令 y=0 再分解。

quiz.q: A parabola has x-intercepts −7 and 3 and a minimum value of −50. What is its vertex?一条抛物线的 x 截距是 −7 和 3，最小值为 −50。顶点是什么？
c: (−2,−50)
(2,−50)
(−5,−50)

quiz.idea: The axis is the midpoint of the zeros; the minimum value is the vertex y-value.对称轴是零点中点；最小值就是顶点纵坐标。

quiz.q: The points (−1,6) and (5,6) are on a parabola whose vertex has y-value −3. Find the vertex and the range if the parabola opens up.点 (−1,6) 和 (5,6) 在一条抛物线上，顶点纵坐标为 −3，开口向上。求顶点和值域。
quiz.a: vertex (2,−3), range y≥−3顶点 (2,−3)，值域 y≥−3
quiz.sol: • Axis x=2−1+5​=2, so the vertex is (2,−3); opening up gives y≥−3.对称轴 x=2−1+5​=2，顶点 (2,−3)；开口向上，值域 y≥−3。
quiz.goal: Use two points at the same height to find the axis, vertex and range.用两个等高的点定出对称轴、顶点和值域。
quiz.idea: Equal y-values mean the points are mirror images, so the axis is their midpoint.y 值相等说明两点互为镜像，对称轴是它们的中点。

quiz.q: For f(x)=x2−4x−12, find all x with f(x)=−12, and the minimum value of f.对 f(x)=x2−4x−12，求所有使 f(x)=−12 的 x，以及 f 的最小值。
quiz.a: x=0 or x=4; minimum −16x=0 或 x=4；最小值 −16
quiz.sol:

  • Axis x=2; f(2)=4−8−12=−16.对称轴 x=2；f(2)=4−8−12=−16。
quiz.goal: Solve f(x)=k using a factoring route and symmetry, then find the minimum.解 f(x)=k 型方程（分解加对称性），再求最小值。

quiz.q: A decorative fountain in a Vancouver plaza shoots a jet of water from a nozzle at ground level, and the jet lands 6 m away. At 1 m from the nozzle the water is 2.5 m high. Let x be the horizontal distance from the nozzle. (a) Find the equation of the path and the maximum height. (b) Between which two horizontal distances is the water at least 4 m high? Use symmetry to explain why the answers are where they are.温哥华广场上的装饰喷泉从地面的喷嘴射出一股水柱，落点距喷嘴 6 m。距喷嘴 1 m 处水柱高 2.5 m。设 x 为到喷嘴的水平距离。(a) 求水柱路径的方程和最大高度。(b) 水柱在哪两个水平距离之间高度至少 4 m？用对称性解释为什么答案落在那两处。
quiz.a: y=−21​x(x−6); maximum 4.5 m at x=3; at least 4 m high for 2≤x≤4y=−21​x(x−6)；最大高度 4.5 m（在 x=3 处）；2≤x≤4 时高度至少 4 m
quiz.sol:
• The jet is at height 0 when x=0 and x=6, so y=ax(x−6). From (1,2.5): 2.5=a(1)(−5), so a=−21​ and y=−21​x(x−6).水柱高度为 0 的位置是 x=0 和 x=6，所以 y=ax(x−6)。代入 (1,2.5)：2.5=a(1)(−5)，得 a=−21​，y=−21​x(x−6)。
  • The axis is the midpoint of the zeros, x=3. Then y=−21​(3)(−3)=4.5, so the maximum height is 4.5 m.对称轴是两个零点的中点 x=3。此时 y=−21​(3)(−3)=4.5，最大高度 4.5 m。
  • Height 4: −21​x(x−6)=4⇒x2−6x+8=0⇒(x−2)(x−4)=0, so x=2 or x=4.高度为 4：−21​x(x−6)=4⇒x2−6x+8=0⇒(x−2)(x−4)=0，得 x=2 或 x=4。
  • Symmetry: 2 and 4 are both 1 m from the axis x=3, so they are mirror images. The parabola opens down, so the water is above 4 m between them: 2≤x≤4.对称性：2 和 4 到对称轴 x=3 的距离都是 1 m，互为镜像。开口向下，所以两者之间水柱高于 4 m：2≤x≤4。
quiz.goal: Build a quadratic model from a real jet of water, then use the axis and symmetry to read off the maximum and the interval above a given height.把真实的水柱建成二次函数模型，再用对称轴和对称性读出最大值，以及高于某个高度的区间。
quiz.idea: Ground level means y=0 at both ends, so the zeros are known: start from factored form and use the extra point for a.落地处 y=0，两个零点已知：从交点式出发，用多出来的那个点求 a。

quiz.a: y=0.02(x−40)2+4; x=20 and x=60; they are mirror images about x=40y=0.02(x−40)2+4；x=20 和 x=60；两者关于 x=40 对称

quiz.goal: Model a hanging cable with a vertex-form parabola, solve for a given height, and justify the answer with symmetry.用顶点式给悬索建模，求给定高度对应的位置，并用对称性说明理由。
quiz.idea: The lowest point is the vertex, and the tower top is a second known point that fixes a.最低点就是顶点，塔顶是第二个已知点，用来确定 a。

quiz.q: The cross-section of a roadside drainage ditch in the Fraser Valley is y=0.5x2−4x+2, where x is the horizontal distance and y is the height, both in metres, measured from the road surface. How deep is the water, and how wide is its surface?弗雷泽河谷一条路边排水沟的横截面是 y=0.5x2−4x+2，其中 x 是水平距离、y 是高度，单位都是米，以路面为基准。(a) 写出顶点式，并说明最低点在路面下多深。(b) 大雨后水面在路面下 4 m。水有多深？水面多宽？
quiz.a: y=0.5(x−4)2−6, lowest point 6 m below the road; water depth 2 m, surface width 4 my=0.5(x−4)2−6，最低点在路面下 6 m；水深 2 m，水面宽 4 m

• Factor 0.5 from the first two terms: y=0.5(x2−8x)+2=0.5(x2−8x+16−16)+2.前两项提出 0.5：y=0.5(x2−8x)+2=0.5(x2−8x+16−16)+2。

  • The water surface is at y=−4, so the depth is −4−(−6)=2 m.水面在 y=−4，所以水深 −4−(−6)=2 m。
  • Surface edges: 0.5(x−4)2−6=−4⇒(x−4)2=4⇒x=2 or x=6. The width is 6−2=4 m.水面两端：0.5(x−4)2−6=−4⇒(x−4)2=4⇒x=2 或 x=6。水面宽 6−2=4 m。

Justify your answer with numbers.BC Place 球场上，踢球手把橄榄球从地面踢出，球落在 50 m 外。视频回放显示球飞到 5 m 远处时高 4.5 m。(a) 把飞行轨迹建成抛物线，求最大高度。(b) 在离踢球手 40 m 的飞行路径上正好挂着一盏 10 m 高的球场灯。球能越过它吗？请用数据说明理由。

quiz.q: A food truck in downtown Vancouver sells 120 bubble teas a day at 6 dollars each, and each drink costs 2.50 dollars to make. Market research says every 25-cent price increase loses 5 sales per day. (a) What price maximises daily profit, ignoring any limits? (b) A city rule caps the price at 7 dollars. What price should the truck charge now, and what is the maximum profit? Explain why your answer to (b) differs from (a).温哥华市中心的一辆餐车每天以 6 加元一杯卖出 120 杯珍珠奶茶，每杯成本 2.50 加元。市场调查显示：每涨价 25 分，每天少卖 5 杯。(a) 不考虑任何限制，定价多少时每日利润最大？(b) 市政规定价格不得超过 7 加元，现在应定价多少？最大利润是多少？解释 (b) 的答案为什么与 (a) 不同。
quiz.a: (a) 7.25 dollars (profit 451.25 dollars); (b) 7 dollars, 100 sales, profit 450 dollars(a) 定价 7.25 加元（利润 451.25 加元）；(b) 定价 7 加元，卖 100 杯，利润 450 加元
quiz.sol:
• Price 6+0.25n, cost 2.50, so profit per drink 3.5+0.25n; sales 120−5n. P=(3.5+0.25n)(120−5n).价格 6+0.25n，成本 2.50，每杯利润 3.5+0.25n；销量 120−5n。P=(3.5+0.25n)(120−5n)。
  • Zeros: n=−14 and n=24. The vertex is halfway, n=5. Price 6+1.25=7.25 dollars, sales 95, P=4.75×95=451.25 dollars.零点：n=−14 和 n=24。顶点在正中间 n=5。价格 6+1.25=7.25 加元，销量 95，P=4.75×95=451.25 加元。
  • (b) Price at most 7 means n≤4. The parabola opens down with its vertex at n=5, so P is still increasing for n≤4 and the best allowed value is the edge n=4.(b) 价格不超过 7 即 n≤4。抛物线开口向下、顶点在 n=5，所以在 n≤4 的范围内 P 一直递增，允许范围内的最优值在边界 n=4。
  • Price 6+1=7 dollars, sales 100, P=4.5×100=450 dollars. Check n=3: 4.25×105=446.25<450 ✓. The cap stops the truck just short of the vertex, costing 1.25 dollars a day.价格 6+1=7 加元，销量 100，P=4.5×100=450 加元。检验 n=3：4.25×105=446.25<450 ✓。限价让餐车停在顶点前一步，每天少赚 1.25 加元。
quiz.goal: Build a profit model, find its maximum, then handle a real-world limit that moves the best choice off the vertex.建立利润模型求最大值，再处理把最优点从顶点移走的现实限制。
quiz.idea: Write profit as (profit per item) × (items sold); the zeros are easy to see. When the vertex is outside the allowed values, the best allowed point is the edge nearest the vertex.利润＝每件利润×销量，零点一目了然。顶点落在允许范围之外时，最优点就是离顶点最近的边界。

diag.q: What is the range of f(x)=−2x2+12x−7?f(x)=−2x2+12x−7 的值域是什么？
c: y≥11
y≤3
y≤11
y≤−61
why: Wrong direction: a=−2<0 opens down, so the vertex is a maximum and the range is y≤.方向反了：a=−2<0 开口向下，顶点是最大值，值域应是 y≤。
Used the vertex x-value 3; the range is about y, so use f(3)=11.用了顶点横坐标 3；值域说的是 y，要用 f(3)=11。
Correct: axis x=−2(−2)12​=3, f(3)=11, opens down, so y≤11.正确：对称轴 x=−2(−2)12​=3，f(3)=11，开口向下，y≤11。
Sign slip in the axis (x=−3), so f(−3)=−61 is not the vertex.对称轴算错了符号（x=−3），f(−3)=−61 不是顶点。
diag.goal: Get the range of a quadratic from its vertex and direction of opening.由顶点和开口方向写出二次函数的值域。
diag.idea: Axis first, then the vertex y-value, then the direction from the sign of a.先求对称轴，再算顶点纵坐标，最后看 a 的符号定方向。

diag.q: A parabola opens down, has x-intercepts −1 and 7, and passes through (1,6). What is its maximum value?一条开口向下的抛物线，x 截距为 −1 和 7，且过点 (1,6)。它的最大值是多少？
c: 6
16
3
8
why: Took the given point as the top; (1,6) is not on the axis x=3.把给的点当成了最高点；(1,6) 不在对称轴 x=3 上。
Skipped finding a (used a=−1); zeros alone do not fix the height.没求 a（直接当 a=−1）；只有零点定不出高度。
Gave the x-coordinate of the vertex; the maximum value is a y-value.给的是顶点横坐标；最大值是纵坐标。
Correct: y=a(x+1)(x−7), 6=a(2)(−6) gives a=−21​; at x=3: −21​(4)(−4)=8.正确：y=a(x+1)(x−7)，6=a(2)(−6) 得 a=−21​；x=3 时 −21​(4)(−4)=8。
diag.goal: Combine the zeros, symmetry and one point to find the maximum value.综合零点、对称性和一个点求最大值。
diag.idea: The axis is the midpoint of the zeros; the extra point only fixes a.对称轴是零点中点；多出来的点只用来求 a。

diag.q: Which equation has vertex (−3,2), opens down, and is narrower than y=x2?哪个方程的顶点是 (−3,2)、开口向下、且比 y=x2 窄？
c: y=−2(x−3)2+2
y=2(x+3)2+2
y=−21​(x+3)2+2
y=−2(x+3)2+2
why: Sign of p: (x−3)2 puts the vertex at x=3, not −3.p 的符号错了：(x−3)2 的顶点在 x=3，不是 −3。
a=2>0 opens up; opening down needs a<0.a=2>0 开口向上；开口向下要 a<0。
∣a∣=21​<1 makes the graph wider, not narrower.∣a∣=21​<1 让图象变宽，不是变窄。
Correct: p=−3, q=2, a=−2 (negative, ∣a∣>1).正确：p=−3，q=2，a=−2（负数且 ∣a∣>1）。
diag.goal: Read vertex, direction and width from a, p, q.由 a、p、q 读出顶点、开口方向和宽窄。
diag.idea: Check three things separately: sign inside the bracket, sign of a, size of ∣a∣.分三项检查：括号内符号、a 的符号、∣a∣ 的大小。

diag.q: A parabola has vertex (2,−8) and passes through (4,0). What are its x-intercepts?抛物线顶点为 (2,−8)，且过 (4,0)。它的 x 截距是什么？
c: 4 only只有 4
0 and 40 和 4
−8 and 4−8 和 4
−2 and 2−2 和 2
why: Forgot the mirror point: every zero has a partner the same distance on the other side of x=2.忘了对称点：每个零点在 x=2 另一侧等距处都有一个对应零点。
Correct: a=(4−2)20+8​=2; 2(x−2)2=8⇒x−2=±2⇒x=0,4.正确：a=(4−2)20+8​=2；2(x−2)2=8⇒x−2=±2⇒x=0,4。
Mixed up heights and intercepts: −8 is the lowest value of y (the vertex height), not a place where the graph crosses the x-axis.把高度和截距弄混了：−8 是 y 的最小值（顶点的高度），不是图象与 x 轴的交点。
Dropped p: solved x2=4 instead of (x−2)2=4.漏了 p：解了 x2=4 而不是 (x−2)2=4。
diag.goal: Build the vertex-form equation, then use it to find the zeros.先写顶点式，再用它求零点。
diag.idea: The axis is x=2, so the known zero 4 has a mirror zero at 0.对称轴是 x=2，已知零点 4 的镜像零点是 0。

diag.q: Write y=x2−10x+18 in vertex form.把 y=x2−10x+18 化成顶点式。
c: y=(x−5)2−7
y=(x+5)2−7
y=(x−5)2+43
y=(x−10)2−82
why: Correct: add and subtract 25: (x−5)2−25+18.正确：加减 25：(x−5)2−25+18。
Sign of half of b: half of −10 is −5, so the bracket is (x−5).b 的一半符号错：−10 的一半是 −5，括号应是 (x−5)。
Added 25 instead of subtracting it, so the value of y changed.把 25 加了上去而不是减掉，y 的值被改变了。
Used b instead of 2b​; (x−10)2 expands to x2−20x+100.用了 b 而不是 2b​；(x−10)2 展开是 x2−20x+100。
diag.goal: Complete the square when a=1.a=1 时配方。

diag.q: Write y=−3x2+12x−5 in vertex form.把 y=−3x2+12x−5 化成顶点式。
c: y=−3(x−2)2−9
y=−3(x+2)2+7
y=−3(x−2)2+7
y=−3(x−2)2−17
why: The −4 left the bracket without being multiplied by a=−3.−4 移出括号时没乘 a=−3。
Factoring out −3 must change +12x to −4x inside: −3(x2−4x).提出 −3 后括号内应是 −4x：−3(x2−4x)。
Correct: −3(x2−4x+4−4)−5=−3(x−2)2+12−5.正确：−3(x2−4x+4−4)−5=−3(x−2)2+12−5。
Multiplied by a but lost the sign: (−3)(−4)=+12, not −12.乘了 a 但符号错：(−3)(−4)=+12，不是 −12。
diag.goal: Complete the square with a negative leading coefficient.首项系数为负时配方。
diag.idea: Factor −3 from the first two terms; the −4 comes out as +12.前两项提出 −3；括号里的 −4 出来变成 +12。

diag.q: What is the vertex of y=−2(x+1)(x−5)?y=−2(x+1)(x−5) 的顶点是什么？
c: (2,−9)
(−2,−14)
(2,18)
(−1,5)
why: Dropped a=−2 when substituting x=2: (3)(−3)=−9 must still be multiplied by −2.代入 x=2 时丢了 a=−2：(3)(−3)=−9 还要乘 −2。
Read the zeros as 1 and −5 (bracket signs not flipped), so the axis came out −2.零点读成 1 和 −5（括号符号没反过来），对称轴错成 −2。
Correct: zeros −1,5, axis x=2, y=−2(3)(−3)=18.正确：零点 −1,5，对称轴 x=2，y=−2(3)(−3)=18。
Took the numbers in the brackets as a point; they give zeros, not the vertex.把括号里的数当成一个点；它们给的是零点，不是顶点。
diag.goal: Get the vertex straight from factored form.由交点式直接求顶点。
diag.idea: Midpoint of the zeros, then substitute into the given form.取零点中点，再代入原式。

diag.q: A parabola has x-intercepts 1 and 5 and passes through (3,−8). In standard form it is:抛物线的 x 截距为 1 和 5，且过 (3,−8)。它的一般式是：
c: y=x2−6x+5
y=2x2−12x+10
y=2x2+12x+10
y=−2x2+12x−10
why: Forgot a: (x−1)(x−5) gives −4 at x=3, not −8.忘了 a：(x−1)(x−5) 在 x=3 处是 −4，不是 −8。

Wrote (x+1)(x+5): those brackets give zeros −1 and −5.写成 (x+1)(x+5)：这样零点是 −1 和 −5。
Sign of a wrong: (2)(−2)=−4, so a=−4−8​=+2.a 的符号错：(2)(−2)=−4，a=−4−8​=+2。
diag.goal: Build factored form from zeros and a point, then expand.由零点和一个点写交点式，再展开。
diag.idea: Zeros give the brackets; the point gives a.零点给括号，点给 a。

diag.q: A ball has height h(t)=−5t2+40t+3 (m). What is its maximum height?小球高度 h(t)=−5t2+40t+3（米）。最大高度是多少？
c: 83 m
4 m
3 m
243 m
why: Correct: t=−2(−5)40​=4, h(4)=−80+160+3=83.正确：t=−2(−5)40​=4，h(4)=−80+160+3=83。
Gave the time of the maximum; the question asks for the height.给的是取最大值的时间；题目问的是高度。

diag.q: 80 m of fence makes a rectangular pen against a barn wall (fence on three sides only). What is the largest possible area?用 80 m 篱笆靠谷仓墙围一个矩形围栏（只围三边）。最大面积是多少？
c: 400 m²
20 m
1600 m²
800 m²
why: Fenced all four sides (a 20 by 20 square); the wall side needs no fence.按四边围（20×20 正方形）；靠墙一边不需要篱笆。
Gave the best width, not the area asked for.给的是最优宽度，不是题目要的面积。
Counted the width only once: x(80−x) ignores the second width.宽只算了一次：x(80−x) 漏了另一条宽。
Correct: A=x(80−2x), zeros 0,40, x=20, A=20×40=800.正确：A=x(80−2x)，零点 0,40，x=20，A=20×40=800。
diag.goal: Model a fencing problem and maximize the area.为围栏问题建模并求最大面积。
diag.idea: Two widths and one length use the fence: 2x+l=80.两条宽加一条长用掉全部篱笆：2x+l=80。
